name: weather-history-demo
description: Demo: periodically fetch weather from Open-Meteo, store it in PostgreSQL, show it in React

scripts.dev:history: concurrently -n history,scheduler -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w history" "npm start -w scheduler"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n fetcher,history,scheduler,frontend -c yellow,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:fetcher" "npm run dev:history" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:fetcher && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w history -w scheduler && cd fetcher && go test ./...
